method: built-in image_gen edits; targeted second pass using close-up hardware photo

jobs.name: 01-front-driver-quarter.png
jobs.prompt:
Precise object replacement edit. Output one landscape photograph with the EXACT same camera, vehicle position/size, beach background and all non-hardware pixels as image 1.
Image 1 is target. Image 2 is an authoritative CLOSE-UP of the actual Malone roof bar and foot. Image 3 shows the spacing of BOTH bars on this exact vehicle. Image 4 shows actual grille.
The target roof hardware is WRONG: it has rounded cylindrical bars, bulbous rounded end caps, tall curved feet, and abbreviated ends. REPLACE that wrong geometry, do not preserve it. Make exactly TWO crossbars that look precisely like the SQUARE/RECTANGULAR-SECTION black metal tube in image 2: flat faces, crisp corners, straight rectangular end caps, about SIX INCHES overhang beyond each clamp. Each bar runs across vehicle left to right, never front to back. The front is over the front seat / B-pillar and rear is over rear-quarter area as image 3. Use FOUR compact black blocky Malone clamps like image 2, seated directly on low grey factory longitudinal rails. No tall curved silver pedestals or arches; no extra crossbars or basket. Lower the black bars and shorten tall feet visibly compared with target, using the close-up. Do not preserve the old rack silhouette where it contradicts reference. Show correct perspective; end-on rectangle visible in profile views.
ALSO replace fine small mesh of front grille with exact image 4 geometry: large chunky black angular rectangular holes, roughly half as many openings as currently, one row above and one row below the thick central band with spaced metal TOYOTA block lettering. The grille should visibly have bigger openings. Retain headlight, bumper and grille exterior contours.
Repeat consistency rules: exactly two black rectangular Malone transverse bars, 4 compact black clamps, low grey factory fore-aft rails. Grey 2004 LC100 body, modest 1.5inch OME lift, stock silver five-spoke wheels, KM3 tires, Bora stance stay unchanged; centered two-inch rear receiver where visible. Keep blank plates, closed doors/hatch, decals and target's existing trim. No invented damage. No people, camping gear or cargo. Do not alter the vehicle's camera angle, framing, background geography or lighting. Output SINGLE full image, not close-up or collage.
